blocks.text: “Amir,” the film entry of GMA Pictures for the 2026 Metro Manila Film Festival just tied up with Columbia Pictures for a possible syndication of the movie. Key executives of GMA Pictures and Brightburn Entertainment, together with the film’s creative team and actors, gathered for the contract signing at the Columbia Pictures Philippines office recently for the distribution of the fantasy drama internationally. Brightburn Entertainment is a production outfit owned by Trillo and his wife Jennylyn Mercado. Representing GMA were Senior Vice President for Programming, Talent Management, Worldwide, and Support Group, and President and CEO of GMA Films Atty. Annette Gozon-Valdes, […]...
